inputAliasPolicy.legalRule: Never infer registrability from a normalized target. Test the raw input glyph and its designated reading against the official lookup snapshot.

legalStatusPolicy.allowed: The exact raw glyph and Hangul reading pair appears in the official lookup snapshot.
legalStatusPolicy.variantAllowed: Reserved for a future separately extracted current Appendix 2 canonical mapping; never inferred from the legacy input-alias map.
legalStatusPolicy.hangulOnly: No Hanja glyph is present; name remains eligible for Hangul-only handling.
legalStatusPolicy.unknown: The curated default pool intentionally does not make a complete legal claim.
legalStatusPolicy.notAllowed: The raw glyph or its supplied reading is absent from the official lookup snapshot.

unihanEnrichment.radicalElementPolicy: Unicode radical metadata is T5 official; Five-Element radical mapping is exposed only as a T3_AUTHORED_INTERPRETATION hint.

notes: The official 2024 announcement counts 9,389 personal-name characters, while the official lookup currently returns 9,495 registrable Unicode/PUA glyph representations.
All 9,495 local glyphs and all 10,381 non-empty local designated-reading pairs match the official lookup exactly.
The 106-representation counting delta must not be treated as an inferred Appendix 2 mapping.
The glyph U+25874 is returned by the lookup but has no non-empty designated personal-name reading, so runtime pair eligibility remains fail-closed.
